name.description: A name in the ledger: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

status.description: Whether work on a project or program goes on.

links.description: Other records, by their paths in the ledger, such as projects/alpha/plans/build.md.

decisions.description: Decisions of the same project or program, each as D and its four-digit number.

path.description: A path inside the ledger: segments of letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, each starting with a letter or digit, so never . or .. and never from the root.

commit.description: A git commit, by its full SHA-1 hash.

pullRequest.description: A GitHub pull request, as owner/name#number.
